decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Design and Access Statement, Location Plan, Photo Montage, Drawing Numbers A478M02A, M01A, received 19/08/11. Drawing Numbers A478 01 C,  02 C, 03 B received 19/10/11.)and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
Condition : 4 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the building.
Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 6 - Details of joinery, brickwork and other architectural features shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Notes of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.
description: Listed building works with external works including the erection of ground floor rear and side extensions, with roof tile replacement and new conservation rooflights to the rear roofslope, replacement front boundary fencing and the erection of a new cycle store and bin store. Internal works including renovation of two bathrooms and the creation of a walk in wardrobe.
